meta.title: Learn Your Way
meta.description: Turns a textbook section into a personalised, multi-view lesson, following the two-stage pipeline of arXiv:2509.13348 (Learn Your Way, LearnLM Team, Google): text personalisation by grade level and interest, then content transformations plus formative assessment. Ask in chat, e.g. "turn this section into a lesson for an 8th grader who likes basketball"; the agent reads the source, re-levels it, writes the rewrite for each rewritten sentence, and calls the learnway tools. Read the result in the sidebar panel Learn Your Way: Immersive Text (personalised sentences highlighted, with See original), a slide presenter (title / section / bullets / quote / two-column layouts, progressive reveal, speaker notes, fullscreen, keyboard navigation), an Audio Lesson, Mind map, Timeline ordering practice, Memory aid, and a section quiz that returns a score with Glows and Grows. The deck also exports to real files: PPTX written by PptxGenJS with the narration in the notes pane, one self-contained offline HTML deck that presents or prints to PDF, and Marp markdown that any Marp toolchain renders to PDF/PPTX/PNG. Flesch-Kincaid grading applies to Latin script; Chinese lessons report a sentence-load estimate instead. Lessons and exports are stored under $DSH_HOME/learnway and stay on this machine; nothing is uploaded. PPTX needs the pptxgenjs dependency and only that format is skipped, with a reason, when it is missing. Two demo lessons are seeded on first run. Turning the plugin off removes the panel and the six learnway_* tools; saved lessons and exports stay on disk.
